sloka: यदि सत्यम् ब्रवीम्येतत्तदसत्यम् भविष्यति ।किम् माम् वक्ष्यति कौसल्या राघवे वनमास्थिते ॥२-१२-६७॥
transliteration: yadi satyam bravīmyetattadasatyam bhaviṣyati ।kim mām vakṣyati kausalyā rāghave vanamāsthite ॥2-12-67॥

translations.english: If Rama takes refuge in the forest, what will Kausalya say to me? Having committed such an unpleasant act, what reply can I give her?
